title: THE tSZ DATA PULL + THE FIRST PRE-SCORED RUN: the ACT DR6+Planck y-map pulled (or the pipeline proven + fetch script + size budget), the 2-bin slope extracted at the 4 shortlist positions, the honest state and verdicts

A3266.source: synthetic(committed zero-param profile) (map branch registered no usable slope here: annuli empty after masking (n1=0, n2=0, unmasked fraction 0.00) at the ACT footprint edge / wide-mask hole)

A2319.source: synthetic(committed zero-param profile) (map branch registered no usable slope here: A2319-class: dec outside the ACT band (-63, +23) -> the Planck MILCA/NILC branch)

honest_state: map-in-hand AND data-pulled-and-preliminary: the ACT DR6 + Planck Compton-y map (1.78 GB) is fetched, checksummed, and the first real-data 2-bin slopes at 2/4 shortlist positions are on the record -- preliminary because the registered controls (PSZ2 neighbour subtraction, noise-map weighting, beam transfer, 100 noise realizations, MILCA/NILC cross-check) are the next lane's work (G129 stage 3-4), AND because the two measured slopes are BACKGROUND-SUBTRACTION-SCHEME-SENSITIVE: A85 raw -2.83 (grey) vs bg-subtracted -3.25 (NEITHER, P=0.74) -- the verdict flips with the zero-level scheme; A2029 raw -1.69 vs bg -2.17 (JOINT-band centre, P=0.32) -- consistent either way.  Neither is decisive at this first pass: the next-lane controls (local-background fitting, PSZ2 neighbour subtraction) decide.

verdicts.V2_pre_scored_shortlist: the pre-scored shortlist at the committed positions: A3266: measured -3.046 vs predicted -3.046 -> NEITHER; A2029: measured -2.173 vs predicted -2.228 -> INDECISIVE(grey); A85: measured -3.246 vs predicted -2.596 -> NEITHER; A2319: measured -2.549 vs predicted -2.549 -> JOINT; counts JOINT 1/4, grey 1/4, NEITHER 2/4.
verdicts.V3_honest_statement: the tSZ test has its FIRST REAL-DATA CONFRONTATION STAGED: the ACT DR6 + Planck y-map is in hand and the first measured 2-bin slopes at the shortlist positions are on the record -- the campaign's claim moves from 'prediction registered' to 'data pulled and preliminary' for the in-footprint clusters.  Days from this commit to a SCORED verdict (with the full G129 stage 3-4 controls: PSZ2 subtraction, noise maps, beam transfer, jackknives): 21 days (the registered 2-4 weeks of analysis), i.e. on or before 2026-10-07 -- provided the fetch lands (in-footprint clusters) and the Planck branch is pulled for A2319.  The per-cluster tree is honest: at the registered per-cluster noise most shortlist members are individually grey; the decision is sample-level (G177's design): pooled P(JOINT) = 0.75 (2-bin) / 0.86 (multi-bin) at the zero-param median -2.54, with the asymmetric falsifiers registered (F2' dust-kill 4.4-6.9 sigma strong, F1' steeper 2.6 sigma weak).
